summary: FIrefox freezes while opening finder to upload files
description:
User Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:89.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/89.0

Steps to reproduce:

Two ways:
1. Open Google Drive, click upload file, Firefox freezes
2. Open new tab, click open file, Firefox freezes

Actual results:

Two ways:
1. Open Google Drive, click upload file, Firefox freezes
2. Open new tab, click open file, Firefox freezes

Expected results:

Two ways:
1. Open Google Drive, click upload file, Firefox does not freeze
2. Open new tab, click open file, Firefox does not freeze
